hook.name: DoubleSineHook
hook.description: Custom AMM hook governing two canonical pools (ETH/TokenA and ETH/TokenB) that share a single virtual ETH reserve. Fully settles all swaps via a custom constant-product curve (DoubleSineMath), charging 1% buy and sell fees to an immutable treasury, with an anti-sniper buy cap during the first 5 blocks after launch.
